name: Drahonín (Czechia)
description: Two vertical stripes of white and navy blue in the ratio 1:1, with a red embattled horizontal stripe across the middle.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 9 October 2007 (decision No. 25) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
